Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses following documents are required to be submitted along with the TECHNICAL B ID for evaluation of the firm :- (1) Copy of PAN card (2) Copy of GST registration certificate (3) Income Tax return or audited balance sheet, profit and loss statement of la st three year (4) Declaration by the firm that firm has not been banned by any govt. depart ment / PSU's. (5) As the service required is specific / critical in nature and may cause signific ant demurrage for any lapse, so MSME relaxation will not be-applicable for prio r turnover / prior experience criteria. (6) Vendor should have valid CHA License for carrying out custom house busin ess at Chennai Sea Port up to Vessel (Ship). Vendor shall enclose valid copy of their CHA License for carrying out custom house business at Chennai Sea Port along with technical bid (7) Vendor should have past experience of handling containerisation of hazard ous materials of UN HD Class I (explosive materials) in 20/40 feet shipping con tainers, inland transportation of the containers by road, warehousing, carrying out custom clearance activities, delivering up to Vessel on FOB basis at any In dian Seaport for the below mentioned quantity during last 5 years to be consid ered from the date of publishing of tender enquiry. (7)(i) For handling 536 (Metric Ton) gross weight of hazardous materials of UN HD Class I (explosive materials) in one Work Order or 50 Nos. of Shipping Cont ainers (minimum 20 feet size) in one Work Order. (7)(ii) Vendor shall enclose copy of such Work Order along with technical bid cl early mentioning the Name of the items exported, UN Hazard Class of the item s exported, Net & Gross Weight of the consignment exported, Number & size o f the shipping containers used, Job description must mentioning logistics/inland road transportation of containers from the shipper up to Seapor t, warehousing, custom clearance and delivery up to Vessel on FOB basis at an y Indian Seaport. Successful job completion certificate against such Work Orde r issued by the order placing company on their company's letter head mention

ing the details of the Work Order with details of the signing authority such as n ame, designation, email & mobile number is required to be enclosed along wit h technical bid. (8) Financial standing of the firm is to be submitted along with technical bid su ch as audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss statement for last 3 Financial Ye ars. The firm should be in business for not less than 3 completed Financial Yea rs and should not have reported loss in last 3 Financial Years. The net worth of the firm should positive. The average annual sales of the firm should be minim um Rupees Twenty Five (25) Crores in all last 03 Financial Years. (9) At the time of closing date of tender i.e. Firm must submitted all valid docu ments as stated above otherwise offers will be summarily rejected Note: It is mandatory that firm has to provide the break up cost of transportatio n per SOC (From OFN (Magazine/Store), Rajgir to Chennai Seaport up to vessel) along with their price bid for making payment of transportation cost incurred du e to price variation. . 2.
